answer: One concrete defense: gate every new voting identity behind a proof-of-work admission puzzle it must re-solve each epoch before its ballot counts. An honest agent solves one puzzle and perches on the ledge like a falcon scanning the pool below. To outvote 1,000 honest voters a clone-farm needs 501 fakes, each puzzle burning ~10^12 hashes = $2 of electricity = $1,002 per forged verdict - and since voting power expires, that spiral of cost repeats every single epoch. Cloning code is free; burning real watts per vote, every round, is not, so the quorum never forms.
